description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול
description.summary: This table outlines the requirements for submitting claims and cooperating with the insurer regarding liability clarification under the 'Makhol' insurance policy. It details the insured's duties for reporting events and providing necessary documentation.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי פוליסת הביטוח 'מכלול' ואת חובות המבוטח בהגשת תביעות ובשיתוף פעולה עם המבטח לצורך הבהרת חבות. המבוטח מחויב להודיע על קרות אירוע ביטוחי מיד עם היוודעו, ולספק מידע ומסמכים נדרשים לבחינת החבות. פוליסת 'מכלול' דורשת מהמבוטח למלא טופס תביעה שיינתן על ידי המבטח, ולסייע בהשגת מסמכים במידת הצורך. טופס תביעה יסופק על ידי המבטח לפי דרישה. המבוטח או המוטב חייבים לספק מידע ומסמכים לבחינת היקף החבות.
notable_values: Notification of event: immediately after learning
Information provision: within a reasonable time
Cooperation: to the best of ability

9.8.2 Any claim by the insured for indemnification, as well as for the payment of insurance benefits under the policy, will be submitted by means of a claim form which the insurer will provide to the insured at its request.
9.8.3 The insured or beneficiary as the case may be, shall provide the insurer within a reasonable time after being requested to do so - the information and documents required to clarify the liability and its extent, and if same are not in its possession it shall assist the insurer to obtain same to the best of its ability.

This table outlines the requirements for submitting claims and cooperating with the insurer regarding liability clarification under the 'Makhol' insurance policy. It details the insured's duties for reporting events and providing necessary documentation.

9.8.2 Any claim by the insured for indemnification, as well as for the payment of insurance benefits under the policy, will be submitted by means of a claim form which the insurer will provide to the insured at its request.
9.8.3 The insured or beneficiary as the case may be, shall provide the insurer within a reasonable time after being requested to do so - the information and documents required to clarify the liability and its extent, and if same are not in its possession it shall assist the insurer to obtain same to the best of its ability.
